name: Roblox Innovation Awards 2024 - Voting Hub
desc:
The Roblox Innovation Awards are back for another year of celebrating the best of the Roblox community! Get ready to support your favorites by voting for the nominee you want to see up on stage accepting the award. This year we're also introducing Quickfire rounds for some of our categories -- where a new one will launch each day for a wild 24 hours of voting. You'll also get to earn points to collect items by predicting who you think will win some of the biggest awards on the platform. Voting opens on July 1 at 10 AM PT. See you then!

🗳️ Vote for your favorite developers and experiences
🔮 Make predictions on who will win
🎁 Unlock event-exclusive UGC items
